subject: Monthly forecast triage & review sprint — manager deliverables and roster
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly forecast triage & review sprint — manager deliverables and roster

Hi team,

As discussed in last week's finance sync, we're kicking off a short review sprint to clean up stage assignments and lock down Q3 commit guidance. Objective: have a consolidated leadership review pack (summary + top 15 deals) ready by EOD Thursday so execs can review Friday morning.

High level asks (owners in parentheses):
- Stage verification: confirm each opportunity stage + expected close month (managers) (Laura/Neha)
- Commit flagging: mark any deals you will commit to in Q3 and provide rationale (top 15) (all)
- Roster & reviewer assignment: confirm who will represent each account at the leadership review (Marcus to consolidate)
- Escalations: highlight any procurement/security blockers that would change commit status

Please use the attached manager_roster.xlsx template and drop updated rows back to me by Tuesday EOD PT. I'll pull a snapshot on Wednesday morning and circulate the leadership pack draft.

Attachments: manager_roster.xlsx (Excel roster template)

Notes: keep updates brief — 1 line per opportunity with stage, commit Y/N, expected close month, and blocker if any.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly forecast triage & review sprint — manager deliverables and roster

Jasmine — thanks for the clear asks. I've started filling out the roster and flagged three deals I think we can comfortably commit to (notes in the comment column). Two quick items:

- For deals in Legal review, I marked them as "commit pending legal" and added expected clearance dates.
- For any deals with procurement dependencies (e.g., SSO / private deployment), I added a separate column for status so Marcus can track escalations.

I'll finish the rest by Tuesday EOD and attach the updated file.

Attached: manager_roster.xlsx (updated, v0.1)

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 12 Jun 2027 08:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly forecast triage & review sprint — manager deliverables and roster

Thanks — looping in a couple of clarifications before I update my accounts tomorrow:

1) Commit definition: are we using a strict revenue-commit threshold (>75% confidence + PO/contract signed) or a softer manager-commit that we'll surface to finance for forecasting? I want to be consistent across my book.
2) Top-15 selection: should we prioritize by ARR or by expected close order value for the next quarter? I have a few mid-size deals that look likely and could bump into top-15 depending on the prioritization.

If it helps, here's my proposed rule: manager-commit = manager confidence >= 70% with active legal/procurement engagement. For the leadership pack, sort top-15 by expected Q3 ARR.

On the roster format, I preserved the one-line-per-opportunity ask and added a short risk line for any deal that needs an exec intervention.

On Tue I'll send my completed file.
